saveError.quota-exceeded: Browser storage is full. Export your project, then delete projects you no longer need.
saveError.unavailable: This browser does not let First Move save. Export your project to keep it.
saveError.write-failed: Saving failed. First Move tries again in a few seconds.
saveError.mirrored: A backup copy of your changes is kept in this browser.

warning.unavailable: This browser cannot store projects reliably, for example in a private window. Export your project to keep it.
warning.low-space: Browser storage is almost full. Export your projects and delete the ones you no longer need.
warning.not-persisted: Your browser may clear stored data when space runs low. Export your project regularly.

notice.changed-elsewhere: This project was changed in another tab. You now see the latest version.
notice.conflict: This project was also changed in another tab. Your version is kept, and the other one is saved as a snapshot.
notice.deleted-elsewhere: This project was deleted in another tab, so it was closed here.
notice.export-reminder: Your project is stored only in this browser. Export a copy to keep it safe.
notice.recovered: Projects restored from a backup copy: {count}
notice.unreadable: Stored projects that could not be read and were left unchanged: {count}
notice.reload-required: First Move was updated in another tab. Reload this page to keep saving.

snapshotReason.deleted-elsewhere: Unsaved changes when deleted in another tab

error.too-large: This file is larger than {max} MB.
error.unreadable: This file could not be read.
error.not-json: This file is not a First Move project (it is not valid JSON).
error.not-first-move: This file is not a First Move project.
error.newer-version: This file comes from a newer version of First Move (format {version}). Reload the app and try again.
error.unsupported-version: This file uses a format that is no longer supported (format {version}).
error.invalid: This file has values First Move cannot accept:

import.migrated: The file was updated to the current format.
import.methodologyChanged: Results are recalculated with methodology {current}. The file was saved with {file}.

error.permission: The browser no longer allows writing to this file.
error.not-found: The linked file was moved or deleted. Link a file again.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.body: The project is removed from this browser. You can undo this only right after deleting, while the message is shown. Export it first to keep a copy.

restore.title: Restore a version
restore.body: First Move keeps earlier versions of this project in this browser. Restoring keeps the current state as a version too.
restore.empty: No earlier versions yet. They are kept while you work.
restore.failed: This version could not be restored.

importFlow.failedTitle: The file could not be imported
importFlow.conflictBody: “{name}” is already stored in this browser. Keep both, or replace the stored version? A replaced version is kept, so you can restore it.

noProject.title: No project open
noProject.body: Open a project on the start screen, or start a new one.

moduleOff.title: {module} is turned off
moduleOff.body: Turn the module on to work on it. Its data is kept while it is off.
